## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1 (continued): The sentinel-pr_number migration rule must be documented. The cycle_ledger.py docstring is the primary location, but the cycle-ledger.md contract doc is the authoritative cross-reference and must reflect the v1.2.0 schema.

## Implementation Notes

Update `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/cycle-ledger.md`:

1. Add a `### Schema v1.2.0` section under the existing schema documentation, describing:
   - Marker grammar: `DSO-Review-Cycle: <hash> pr_number=<int> commit_sha=<sha> findings_hash=<hash> tuples=<list>`
   - New required field `pr_number` (integer)
   - Reader/writer contract: writer emits v1.2.0 only; reader tolerates v1.0.0, v1.1.0, v1.2.0.

2. Add a `### Sentinel-pr_number Migration Rule` subsection:
   - v1.1.0 entries materialize with pr_number=0 (sentinel).
   - Sentinel pr_number matches ANY pr_number filter until superseded by a v1.2.0 entry for that specific pr_number on the same sha.
   - Writers MUST NEVER emit pr_number=0.

3. Update the "Backward-Compatibility" section to reflect the new tolerance contract.

4. Cross-link to the cycle_ledger.py module docstring and to the DefenseStore docs.

Doc-router gate: **Gate 2** fired (existing reference doc — cycle-ledger.md contract). Emit DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION per the contract.

This is a documentation-only task with testing_mode=GREEN; no behavioral test required (per behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5, instruction/contract docs cannot be deterministically tested).

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Associated tests | Test classification |
|-------------|--------|------------------|---------------------|
| `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/cycle-ledger.md` | modify | n/a (instruction file) | still-valid |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] cycle-ledger.md contains v1.2.0 schema documentation
  Verify: grep -q 'v1.2.0\|1\\.2\\.0' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/cycle-ledger.md
- [ ] Sentinel-pr_number migration rule documented
  Verify: grep -q 'sentinel.*pr_number\|pr_number.*sentinel' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/cycle-ledger.md
- [ ] DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION emitted in commit message
  Verify: git log -1 --pretty=%B | grep -q 'DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION' || true  # checked at commit time

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet\xe2\x86\x92opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
